definitions.explanation: sending liquid, gas, or other material through pipes or channels using applied pressure

{圧送|あっそう}⟦{管|かん}→管：09749_kan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|つう}じて→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧⟦{汚水|おすい}→汚水：09654_osui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処理場|しょりじょう}→処理場：09653_shorijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: Wastewater is sent to the treatment plant through a pressure pipe.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高層|こうそう}ビル→高層ビル：16994_kousoubiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上階|じょうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{届|とど}ける→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{強力|きょうりょく}→強力：02656_kyouryoku⟧な⟦ポンプ→ポンプ：11594_ponpu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{圧送|あっそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: To deliver water to the upper floors of a high-rise building, powerful pumps are needed to force it through under pressure.

notes:
A technical term used in construction, plumbing, and engineering for moving materials through pipes using applied pressure. Most commonly encountered in concrete pumping ({生|なま}コン{圧送|あっそう}) at construction sites and in wastewater management.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {圧送|あっそう}⟦ポンプ→ポンプ：11594_ponpu⟧: pressure pump
- {圧送|あっそう}⟦{管|かん}→管：09749_kan⟧: pressure pipe
- ⟦コンクリート→コンクリート：10858_konkuriito⟧{圧送|あっそう}: concrete pumping
- {圧送|あっそう}⟦{方式|ほうしき}→方式：05454_houshiki⟧: pressure-feed system

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{送水|そうすい}→送水：24011_sousui⟧: water delivery — sending water, not necessarily under pressure
- ⟦{加圧|かあつ}→加圧：16628_kaatsu⟧: pressurization — applying pressure in general, not specifically for sending material
- ⟦{揚水|ようすい}→揚水：29738_yousui⟧: water pumping/lifting — pumping water upward, as from a well
